title: census.py run takes no topic or directory selection, so a census of one domain runs its phases 0 and 1 as separate factdiff.py and census.py commands
goal: census.py run accepts the selection factdiff.py detect takes (--topic, --dir, --file or --source) and runs its steps (detect, apply, check, repin, index, the phase-1 commit, summary) on those sources only, with the census log covering them alone; a run with no selection is unchanged

run:
import subprocess, sys
def steps(*extra):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/census.py", "run", "--date", "2026-01-01", "--dry-run", *extra], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return r.returncode, {l.split(":", 1)[0].split()[-1]: l.split(":", 1)[1].strip() for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("step ")}, r.stderr[-200:]
code0, plain, _ = steps()
code1, picked, err = steps("--dir", "ad")
bad = []
if code0 or plain.get("detect") != "python3 _tools/factdiff.py detect --date 2026-01-01 --sitemaps" or "--source" in plain.get("check", "--source"):
    bad.append("a run with no selection changed")
if code1 or "--dir ad" not in picked.get("detect", "") or "--source" not in picked.get("check", ""):
    bad.append("a run with --dir ad does not pass the selection to detect and the selected sources to check")
print(bad, err)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

gates.question: When census.py run has no selection and factdiff-<date>.csv is the free detect log, does its detect step still name the log with --out?
options: omit --out when the log is factdiff-<date>.csv, the name detect picks itself
gates.recommendation: omit --out when the log is factdiff-<date>.csv, the name detect picks itself
gates.reason: the argv of a run with no selection is then as before BG-7zpe7p3w, as the item's repro requires, and a rerun with that name taken still names -N
gates.answer: omit --out when the log is factdiff-<date>.csv, the name detect picks itself

gates.question: Which sources does the check step of a selected census.py run take: every source the selection names, or only those detect reads?
options: every source the selection names, as a run with no selection takes every source
only the sources detect reads (cited, not superseded)
gates.recommendation: every source the selection names, as a run with no selection takes every source
gates.reason: the census log then covers the selection the way the full census covers all sources
gates.answer: every source the selection names, as a run with no selection takes every source

notes: Planner: the selection reaches detect as the same flags and the check step as --source for each selected source id (census.py check has --source). Premise: the repro exits 1 on 55dde769f (argparse refuses --dir); its no-selection arm already holds.
